day_shape: 92 items: IDF kills Hamas internal security chief Naim Abu Nahal in Gaza City strike, UK sanctions Houthis, three tankers hit in Strait of Hormuz with IRGC claiming naval mines, rial past 2.85m/USD, heavy Khamenei population-policy cycle.

threads.label: Hamas internal security chief killed in Gaza
threads.summary: The IDF and Shin Bet confirmed killing Naim Muhammad Abu Nahal, head of Hamas's internal security apparatus, in a strike in Gaza City. Netanyahu and Katz confirmed the strike; Hamas's interior ministry and Gaza's health authorities confirmed the death, noting Abu Nahal had taken the role roughly two months earlier after his predecessor's capture.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz tanker strikes
threads.summary: UKMTO reported three vessels struck by unidentified projectiles while transiting east through the Strait of Hormuz on Monday. The IRGC told Iranian media the three oil tankers caught fire after hitting naval mines; the US is investigating possible Iranian responsibility for cyberattacks and bomb threats against oil tankers worldwide.

threads.label: US blockade squeeze on Iranian economy
threads.summary: Iran's rial fell past 2.85 million to the dollar on the open market, and the US Treasury sanctioned 22 entities and 8 people linked to Iran's shadow banking networks, identifying $14.7bn in potentially linked transactions. Iran International reported disillusionment with Russia and China across Iran's political camps, while Tehran denied preparing a tanker convoy to break the blockade and said a US land blockade would be near-impossible.

threads.label: UK sanctions on Houthis
threads.summary: The FCDO announced new UK sanctions against the Houthis and top officials following renewed Houthi aggression inside Yemen and against Saudi Arabia. The Yemen designations list on gov.uk was updated the same morning.

threads.label: Flogging of singer Parastoo Ahmadi
threads.summary: Lawyers confirmed that singer Parastoo Ahmadi and four members of her production team received 74 lashes each over a YouTube concert performed without a hijab. The punishment prompted condemnation from artists and activists on social media.

threads.label: Khamenei population-policy message cycle
threads.summary: Khamenei's office pushed a sustained cycle of posts around his message to the fourth National Young Population Award event, calling population increase strategic for a stronger Iran and demanding remedies to past policies. The message was read aloud by Marzieh Vahid Dastjerdi; President Pezeshkian also issued a condolence message for writer Reza Amirkhani.

threads.label: IRGC commanders on post-regional warfare
threads.summary: IRGC commander Vahidi said on regime channels that future warfare will no longer be purely regional and the battlefield could expand, while Chief of Staff Abdollahi claimed US bases in the region remain within range of Iranian forces and were heavily damaged. Jerusalem Post cited a Lebanese report that IRGC personnel and logistics had withdrawn from Beirut's Dahiyeh to the Bekaa Valley.

events.title_en: New list of transaction purpose codes implemented in banking systems Central Bank: From 27 Azar 1405, a new list of 41 transaction purpose codes will be implemented in all banking systems such as SATNA, PAYA, PAL and cheques.
events.summary_en: New list of transaction purpose codes implemented in banking systems Central Bank: From 27 Azar 1405, a new list of 41 transaction purpose codes will be implemented in all banking systems such as SATNA, PAYA, PAL and cheques. From this date, individuals wishing to conduct banking transactions or register cheques must select the purpose and reason for money transfer from these 41 new codes, and there will no longer be the possibility of using previous codes for recording new transactions. The purpose of this change is to make banking transactions more transparent and to clarify the reason for money transfers.
